### The work in Henry David Thoreau’s thought

Henry David Thoreau (1817–1862) was an American essayist, naturalist, and political dissenter of the Concord Transcendentalist circle. Walden (1854) recounts deliberate life at Walden Pond; “Civil Disobedience” justifies refusal of unjust tax. [More on Henry David Thoreau](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/henry-david-thoreau) .
